headline: Shell Q3 Profit Rises to $10.8 Billion on Record Refining Margins
summary: Shell reported third-quarter adjusted earnings of $10.8 billion, nearly doubling from a year earlier. Higher LNG prices and record refining margins boosted profits amid Middle East fuel supply squeezes.
why: Shell is one of the world's largest integrated oil and gas supermajors, whose financial performance reflects global energy supply and demand dynamics.

impacts.name: Shell plc
impacts.why: Doubled Q3 profit driven by high refining margins and trading activity strengthens balance sheet.
